reuse.why: Changes the existing shared range helper and routes the one site that had its own midpoint formula (schedule-template) through it as well.

duplication.why: Adds no new logic copies and removes one; the pre-existing per-site 'null ? 0 : number ? v : range' dispatches are left in place although getScheduledAmount already covers number and range.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree keeps schedule amount helpers, and every layer imports it.

scope.why: Focused on the rule; the rename of getRangeMidpoint touches all call sites and comments, which is justified but widens the diff slightly.

maintainability.why: One named function owns the ranged-amount rule with a test, so the next change is a one-line edit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All ranged-amount sites call getRangeExpectedAmount (directly or via getScheduledAmount)

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic introduced; the schedule-template copy is replaced by the shared helper

one_place.where: getRangeExpectedAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by schedule-template, forecast-schedules, schedules/app (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and getScheduledAmount
